name: Ward
description: A basic protective ward every student learns in their first week.

name: Ember Bolt
description: A small dart of flame. The first offensive spell taught to mages.

name: Fire Wall
description: Raise a wall of flame that burns anyone who enters or lingers.

name: Mending
description: Knit small wounds and steady frayed nerves.

description.text: You read your reserves to the drop — a precise inner gauge of how much you hold and how fast it ebbs.
You can feel roughly how full you are — a vague sense of high or low, brightening as you practise.
You reach inward and feel only a confused warmth; whether your reserves are full or nearly spent, you honestly cannot tell.
